name: M43 Burger Bar-BQ
kurzbeschreibung:
**M43 Burger Bar-BQ in Füssen**

Discover the ultimate burger and BBQ experience in the heart of the **Alps**! At **M43 Burger Bar-BQ**, we fire up the grill with passion and serve up mouthwatering flavors that will leave you craving more.

Our menu features **juicy burgers** made with the finest ingredients, paired with **smoky BBQ classics** that bring the taste of the outdoors to your plate. Whether you're in the mood for a classic **Cheeseburger**, a spicy **BBQ Rib**, or a creative twist like our **M43 Special**, we’ve got something for every palate.

Savor your meal in a cozy, rustic setting—perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes. Don’t forget to try our **homemade desserts**, including a fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** to finish your feast.

Located in the charming town of **Füssen**, just steps away from **Neuschwanstein Castle**, **M43 Burger Bar-BQ** is the ideal spot for food lovers and adventure seekers alike. Come taste the magic—where great food meets unforgettable moments!
